text:
```yaml
name: Add Emojis

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate-dispatch-workflow:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download
      
      - name: Validate dispatch workflow
        run: go test ./... -run TestDispatchWorkflowValidationWithoutAgenticWorkflowsTool
```
